notes:
Features
- Deployment templates: Save as new template (copy a loaded template under a new name)
- Workspaces: deployment scope (Geographical / Regional) shown, and chosen in New workspace

Fixes
- Session host configuration pools: ephemeral OS disk, gallery image and role assignment deployment failures fixed
- New host pools: reserved subnets hidden, VM size checks improved, Regional scope warned about
- Workspaces: Add to workspace and the New application group workspace list fixed
- Delete host pool: clearer confirmation of what is deleted and kept
- Ephemeral OS disk hosts: Deallocate skips them, and scaling plans warn when power management can't stop them
- Scaling plans: dynamic minimum pool size limited to Azure's 0-59
- Remove session hosts: the last host can be removed too (the pool is kept with no VMs)
- Remove session hosts / Delete host pool: can also delete the hosts' AD computer accounts and Entra ID devices
